description: Describe a task, pain point or desired feature in plain English or Portuguese (max 300 chars). Assembles validated catalog filters (kind, topic, transport, verified seals), runs tiered FULLTEXT retrieval and lexical/AI reranking, and returns both the structured filters and ranked MCP servers, skills or plugins. Authenticated MCP accounts receive 1 free query/day; unauthenticated MCP or extra queries are paid per call via credit/x402 (or use GET /api/x402/smart-filter without an account). Translates natural-language prompts (English or Portuguese, max 300 chars, with unified SDK anti-prompt-injection guard, OWASP security alerting on abuse patterns and 5s burst cadence) into validated catalog filters (`kind`, `topic`, `transport`, `eco`, `origin`, `repo`, `trusted`), runs a 3-tier MySQL FULLTEXT ladder with 10-minute normalized cache, applies deterministic lexical reranking and upgrades planning/top-20 permutation-only reranking via the unified internal SDK AI service (`services/ia` via Rota Nacional). Channel policy: browser UI verified with Cloudflare Turnstile receives 1 free personalized query/day (within a 100/day product-wide cap); authenticated MCP (`POST /mcp` with `X-Api-Key: mmk_…` or OAuth `Bearer mmo_…`) receives 1 free query/day; direct HTTP API calls and unauthenticated MCP calls are paid-only (HTTP 402 via account balance, prepaid credit `cred_…`, Pix or x402 USDC on Base). For accountless pay-per-call agents, `GET /api/x402/smart-filter` offers the same pay-per-call flow.

kind.description: Optional explicit kind lock: mcp, skill or plugin.

lang.description: Language for the filter explanation (en or pt).

limit.description: Maximum number of ranked tools to return (default 24, max 50).

query.description: Natural-language question, pain point or feature description (2 to 300 chars).

transporte.description: Optional explicit transport lock: http, sse or local.

trusted.description: True to return only verified listings with active seals.
